recognition.notFound.help: Not found does not mean the credential cannot be recognised.

guides.title: Application guides
guides.intro: This site helps you build a shortlist. Applications must be submitted by you through the official institutional or employer channel.
guides.body: Choose the language of instruction first, then check admission language evidence, extra language needs for placements or clinics, tuition terms, and the current application round. A CSCSE lookup is a reference, not a personal recognition guarantee. Research jobs use working language and doctoral enrollment filters, not teaching-language filters.
home.researchHelp: The research-jobs entry does not require a teaching-language choice first.
footer.disclaimer: This site does not invent admission odds or user reviews. Unknown tuition is not free. Closed vacancies are removed from public lists.
meta.description: Search Czech degree programmes and paid research jobs in Chinese, English, and Czech. Interface language is stored separately from language of instruction.
clinical.cs.required: Czech required for clinical work or placement
